results.finding: sections, unit counts and unit forms match the spec

Audited all 30 aligned prose/list units, p01-p30, in structure.json order; the independent summaries match the planned controlling ideas from attention to capability through the final system-level generation question. The KEY POINTS summary is retained as an unmapped callout, not an extra paragraph; no planned unit is missing, displaced, merged, or replaced.

Audited p01-p30 and the opening callout; the outliner flagged no unit as needing two summaries, and direct review agrees. The cost list p10, qualified three-job comparison p12, linked organizational examples p20, six review questions p27, and integrated conclusion p28 each develop one controlling idea through related examples or synthesis.

Audited every unit and attachment: p01-p11 establish S1 with S5 cost limits; p03-p04 also announce S2-S6; p12-p14 develop S2; p15-p18 develop S3; p19-p22 develop S4 with S5 limits; p23-p24 establish S5; p25-p27 apply S6; p28-p30 synthesize S1-S4/S6 and the consequence for production planning. The callout, four tables, three figures, and annotated reference list reinforce these claims without an unrelated argumentative unit.

Audited all 35 specified evidence items across p01-p30, including both statistics, two NRC quotations, eight source items, three analogies, three examples, ten reasoning items, four tables, and three figures, against draft.md; also checked the callout and annotated references. The cost list and Figure 1 distinguish nuclear island from core, preserve the historical/direct-cost caveats, and yield an explicitly directional inference; the three-job table/Figure 2 explain the qualified IAEA comparison and each AI role; the defense examples/Figure 3 explain independence under failure; the limits and Monday tables state what each comparison or action means, with surrounding prose interpreting their relevance. This is an audit of the supplied argument and explanations, not a new external verification of the nuclear claims.

Audited all 29 consecutive unit boundaries: 20 within-container transitions and all nine section/conclusion transitions, plus the written local hand-off. Elaboration, contrast, support, cause/effect, similarity, example, and summary relationships carry the specified known material forward: p03 explicitly identifies the capability questions before contrasting dependable use, p12 asks why the already-costed plant exists, p15 asks what happens when the controls fail, p19-p24 expand then limit the analogy, and p25-p30 move from implications through review to synthesis and the next inquiry.

Both independent readers recover the prerequisite order from reactor function and cost through AI responsibilities, safeguards, wider operation, limitations, and application; their section accounts also match the assertion-evidence-reasoning sequences, the increase from engineering to organizations and society, and the qualified move into Monday actions and team questions. Neither reader proposes reordering a whole section or loses the main argument; flow-reader-1 reports no trouble, and flow-reader-2 reports only the separate local p12 reread recorded below.

results.draft_locus: The Three Jobs of the Plant ¶1
results.quote: The labels are not identical (the IAEA's "remove the heat" is about cooling the core safely, where the plant's *channel* job is about converting that heat into sellable electricity), but the shape is the same: three things any plant — nuclear or AI — has to do with a raw power source.
results.finding: Flow reader 2, issue 1, reports a local reread because the paragraph asks the reader to distinguish the IAEA safety functions from the author's jobs before the table has fully presented the latter; the table then resolves the distinction. This is not independently corroborated: flow reader 1 explicitly says the paragraph makes the difference between channeling and cooling understandable, so this finding records only one reader's local difficulty.

Audited first uses and paragraph openings across the callout, p01-p30, tables, and captions against the practitioner framing present in the introduction; this spec supplies no explicit audience knowledge lists. The reactor is introduced as a heat source, nuclear island and the differing cost bases are explained beside their figures, the three jobs receive operational examples, control plane receives an inline gloss, and defense in depth is defined before its AI application; neither reader identifies an unresolved unknown term. The p12 comparison-density issue is reported separately under flow and does not leave channel or the IAEA functions undefined.

Audited the callout and p01-p04: the specific reactor/model contrast establishes the production-use thesis and an ordered roadmap, rather than filling space, restating an assigned question, opening with a dictionary definition, invoking a generic historical sweep, or reporting on a book. The capability questions lead into the article's own answer about intended behavior and surrounding engineering.

Audited Closing Thought p28-p30: the ending combines costs, safeguards, and human responsibilities into a product-plan implication, then gives a course of action and a consequence to examine next. It does not withhold the thesis, rely on an unrelated emotional appeal, add evidence belonging in the body, or end on a bare restatement; the final generation question follows the established conversion criterion and is the specified hand-off, not a new argumentative detour.

Closing Thought p28 makes the earlier cost evidence, safeguard design, and accountable operating model parts of one product plan whose combined outcome is a dependable service; p29 turns that synthesis into the work the team should undertake. This joins the separate sections and explains why their shared investment belongs in delivery planning, satisfying both the synthesis and the practical consequence.

Closing Thought p28 returns to the introductory fascination with the core through the contrast between a genuine marvel and a power station, while p29 redirects effort from increasing model power to trustworthy use. That directly fulfills the specified callback to admiration of capability and the opening model-comparison questions.

The introduction-only reader predicts reactor function and plant cost, the control/channel/contain mapping and independent safeguards, organizational and societal responsibilities, explicit limitations, and practical production actions and questions; all four roadmap promises are fulfilled by the eight body sections. Its prediction of attributed nuclear evidence plus reasoned AI examples and a confident but qualified practitioner tone matches the draft; the reader's open possibility of measured AI cases was not an expectation that the article must supply them.

results.draft_locus: The Three Jobs of the Plant; Defense in Depth: No Single Guardrail
results.finding: The AC-1 cold reader correctly maps control to permitted scope/instructions/tools, channel to evaluated and structured checkable results, and contain to sandboxing, review, limits, and rollback; it explains that an independent next safeguard must still work when another fails. The response meets every expected distinction and identifies the absence of a deployment architecture only as an appropriate limit, not a missing answer.

results.draft_locus: Most of the Plant Is Not the Core; Where the Analogy Breaks
results.finding: The AC-2 cold reader states the directional surrounding-work inference, distinguishes nuclear island from bare core and the historical DOE direct-cost denominator, and rejects universal ratios or an AI budget formula. It also identifies different physical hazards, changing model behavior, less-settled standards, and useful raw-model applications, meeting the required bounds of the analogy.

results.draft_locus: What to Do on Monday; Questions to Consider; Closing Thought
results.finding: The AC-3 cold reader proposes staffing and scheduling evaluation, controls, workflows, observability, review, and independent safeguards; measuring correct checkable output through evaluation and escaped-defect rates; and naming the accountable human and retained human decisions. It connects these investments to the gap between a demo and dependable production use, while correctly declining to infer exact ratios or thresholds.
